text: Free demo: you're a hole in the ground.
And you swallow the farm. Apples, eggs, crops, all of it.
Open card packs to unlock new trees and animals, plant them, and sell what you collect.
Best part: upgrade the hole and it slurps up everything at once.
The catch? The customers you trade with look stiff and basic.
The demo is under five hundred megabytes, in twelve languages.
Think Donut County, running a farm business.
Worth a dip if you've always wanted to be a hole.
